name: lattice
description: A research knowledge workspace: annotate paper PDFs, write linked notes with wikilinks and backlinks, and see it all in a force directed knowledge graph.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: npm --prefix client run test && node --test server/ai.test.js server/arxiv.test.js server/openAccess.test.js server/openAccess.ratelimit.test.js server/suggest.test.js server/plan.test.js desktop/serve.test.mjs && npm --prefix mcp run test
scripts.mcp:build: npm --prefix mcp install && npm --prefix mcp run build
